ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: A block of mass \(m\) slides down a plane inclined at an angle \(\theta\) to the horizontal with kinetic friction coefficient \(\mu_k\). What is the block's acceleration down the incline?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure there is a pink block labeled m, placed on a green inclined plane; the inclined plane forms an angle θ relative to the horizontal plane; the arrow a points downward along the inclined plane indicating the direction of acceleration; μ_k is also marked in the figure, indicating that kinetic friction exists at the contact surface. The problem statement confirms that the block slides downward along the inclined plane, therefore the direction of the kinetic friction force is upward along the inclined plane. Reasoning: Take one coordinate axis parallel to the inclined plane and one axis perpendicular to the inclined plane. The component of gravity mg downward along the inclined plane is mg sinθ, and the component perpendicular to the inclined plane is mg cosθ. There is no acceleration in the direction perpendicular to the inclined plane, so the normal force N = mg cosθ. The magnitude of the kinetic friction force is f_k = μ_k N = μ_k mg cosθ, and the direction is upward along the inclined plane. Taking the downward direction along the inclined plane as the positive direction, from Newton's second law we get ma = mg sinθ - μ_k mg cosθ, therefore a = g sinθ - μ_k g cosθ.

raw_record.question_text: A block of mass \(m\) slides down a plane inclined at an angle \(\theta\) to the horizontal with kinetic friction coefficient \(\mu_k\). What is the block's acceleration down the incline?

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: a block labeled m rests on an inclined plane making angle θ with the horizontal; the arrow labeled a points down the slope, and μ_k indicates kinetic friction on the contact. Use the text to confirm the block is sliding down, so friction acts up the incline. Choose axes parallel and perpendicular to the plane. Resolve gravity into mg sinθ down the incline and mg cosθ perpendicular to the plane. Since there is no perpendicular acceleration, N = mg cosθ. Kinetic friction has magnitude f_k = μ_k N = μ_k mg cosθ and points up the incline. Apply Newton’s second law along the incline: ma = mg sinθ − μ_k mg cosθ, giving a = g sinθ − μ_k g cosθ.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：附图中有一个粉色方块标为 m，放在绿色斜面上；斜面相对水平面形成角 θ；箭头 a 沿斜面向下指示加速度方向；图中还标出 μ_k，表示接触面存在动摩擦。题干确认方块沿斜面向下滑动，因此动摩擦力方向沿斜面向上。推理：取坐标轴一轴平行斜面、一轴垂直斜面。重力 mg 沿斜面向下的分量为 mg sinθ，垂直斜面的分量为 mg cosθ。垂直斜面方向无加速度，所以支持力 N = mg cosθ。动摩擦力大小为 f_k = μ_k N = μ_k mg cosθ，方向沿斜面向上。沿斜面向下取正方向，由牛顿第二定律得 ma = mg sinθ - μ_k mg cosθ，因此 a = g sinθ - μ_k g cosθ。
method.model_answer: The block's acceleration down the incline is \(a = g\sin\theta - \mu_k g\cos\theta\).
